N-add15#1.t: Don't run! Stop right there, all of you!

N-add15#2.zh: 可恶！真是穷追不舍...我看这样吧，留下一个人与我阻挡追兵，其余的人先走...
N-add15#2.t: Damn! They just won't let up... Here's what we'll do: one of you stays with me to hold off the pursuers, and the rest go on ahead...

N-add15#4.zh: 那么，三个时辰后大家在石碣村前面碰头。
N-add15#4.t: Then we'll meet in front of Stone Tablet Village in three hours.

N-add15#6.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败所有敌人

N-add15#9.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N-add15#10.zh: 断后失败，众好汉被官兵追上，一一死于刀下........
N-add15#10.t: The rearguard failed. The soldiers caught up with the heroes and cut them down one by one........

N-add15#11.zh: 经过一场恶战，终于逃脱了官兵的追捕。
N-add15#11.t: After a fierce battle, they finally escaped the soldiers' pursuit.
